definitions.explanation: A document that lists items, amounts, or details in a breakdown format. Used for pay slips, medical bills, utility bills, credit card statements, and patent specifications.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給与|きゅうよ}→給与：00264_kyuuyo⟧{明細書|めいさいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{医療費|いりょうひ}→医療費：24692_iryouhi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明細書|めいさいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: I received a detailed statement of medical expenses.

examples.english: There was an unfamiliar charge on my credit card statement, so I contacted the card company.

notes:
USAGE:
{明細書|めいさいしょ} is a common business and daily-life term for any document that provides a detailed breakdown. The shorter form ⟦{明細|めいさい}→明細：06448_meisai⟧ is also frequently used.

Common types of {明細書|めいさいしょ}:
- {給与|きゅうよ}{明細書|めいさいしょ}: pay slip, salary statement
- ⟦{医療費|いりょうひ}→医療費：24692_iryouhi⟧{明細書|めいさいしょ}: medical expense statement
- ⟦クレジットカード→クレジットカード：06968_kurejittokaado⟧{明細書|めいさいしょ}: credit card statement
- ⟦{特許|とっきょ}→特許：13467_tokkyo⟧{明細書|めいさいしょ}: patent specification

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {明細書|めいさいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to issue a detailed statement
- {明細書|めいさいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check a statement
- {明細書|めいさいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧: to keep a statement on file
